caption: The video captures a wide beach at sunset, where a layered sky of orange, yellow and teal clouds hangs above a glowing horizon. A band of ocean stretches across the middle, edged by a line of breaking white foam that continuously reshapes and shifts in thickness and vertical position throughout the excerpt. In the foreground, a thin sheet of water over wet sand mirrors the warm sky colors, its reflections shimmering subtly frame to frame. A dark diagonal channel runs across the sand and stays fixed, marking a static surface feature rather than a moving object. The surf is already mid-cycle when the clip opens and continues to advance and recede without resolving into a clear crest or drain. The cloud shapes and bright sun-glow remain essentially unchanged over the short span. The camera holds a steady view.
relations: The advancing and receding surf continuously reshapes the white foam band's thickness and vertical position.
The thin foreground water sheet mirrors the sky, shimmering subtly as the surface shifts.
The dark diagonal channel remains a fixed surface feature on the wet sand.
The layered clouds and bright horizon glow stay essentially unchanged during the short clip.
